Tests cover drift, malformed controls, duplicate/nonfinite JSON, wrong audit and arbitrary dispatch refusal.

The outer process creates STARTED.json exclusively, flushes and fsyncs it before dispatch or original input access. Coordinator and worker capabilities are parent/group-bound, random-token-bound and exclusively claimed once. Any later failure leaves the attempt spent. Only the authorized coordinator opens the original CAD: one bounded O_NOFOLLOW regular descriptor read after STARTED and the coordinator claim, checked for stable descriptor metadata, exact size and exact hash. The original descriptor closes before native worker launch. The worker rechecks only its private snapshot bytes; native translation receives a private STEP path, never the original raw path.

The native worker uses isolated Python startup, a fresh namespace containing only the frozen diagnostic package, a clean single-thread environment and the pinned generic Python I/O guard. The guard is installed before diagnostic/native imports and denies Python-level outside-scope reads, external processes, sockets and process-group changes. Only private scratch is writable. The worker inherits the coordinator's dedicated process group and stdout/stderr pipe.

The STEP reader sequence retains the frozen V1 unit-binding body; its exact AST equivalence is covered by the passed diagnostic controls. The separately verified frozen reader source hash is 55243b2a557e77a9c50e27a7fdef9257d60ed2468bc23c1788c391d7a836bdba. One imported solid handle proceeds directly to the unchanged analyzer, without post-import healing or an alternate geometry pipeline.

Topology is bounded before analyzer construction: 4096 occurrences, depth 32, 2048 unique shapes and fixed per-type limits. Detail work is bounded to 1024 entities, 32 statuses/list, 64 contexts/entity, 4096 total context records and 768 KiB structured JSON. Missing/unsupported/truncated status evidence remains PARTIAL_DIAGNOSTIC or UNAVAILABLE; a favorable observed prefix cannot be called complete.

The outer watchdog owns the 120-second absolute deadline from execute entry. Normal work ends by 110 seconds, leaving a 10-second reserve inside the total. Soft deadlines rearm the independent hard alarm before raising. The hard handler kills the known coordinator group and exits without cooperative waits or recursive cleanup; coordinator cleanup remains inside that independently killable group.

The live watcher samples the entire dedicated coordinator group, including reparented same-group members, plus the outer process and its monitor descendants without double counting. Missing active-coordinator/outer accounting fails closed. Worker CPU is capped at 90 seconds, sampled complete-group-plus-outer RSS at 1 GiB, and live combined coordinator/native stdout/stderr at 1 MiB. Kill/reap confirmation uses a single bounded absolute window. STARTED remains spent even if a hard exit or blocked filesystem prevents a terminal receipt.

Successful completion additionally requires one native-worker terminal record, exact result/log/claim bindings, completed private-cache cleanup and unchanged source/runtime metadata after work. DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE means completed evidence collection and does not imply native_valid is true. Observed bend count remains null, predictions are not computed and production use is false.
